selector-kinds.all: Any recognized member set; path, value, and values are inert when present
selector-kinds.gte: Exactly {kind: "gte", path: path, value: numeric_bound} — the value at path must be same-tag numeric and numerically ≥ bound (inclusive)
selector-kinds.lte: Exactly {kind: "lte", path: path, value: numeric_bound} — the value at path must be same-tag numeric and numerically ≤ bound (inclusive)
